entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Court No. - 13
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8533 of 2022

Applicant :- Nadeem S/O Sri Lateef
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru Prin Secy Home Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Suresh Kumar Yadav,Farooq Ayoob

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.
Heard Shri Farooq Ayoob, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Nadeem for grant of bail, in Case Crime No. 181 of 2022, under Section 376 I.P.C., Police Station- Haidergarh, District- Barabanki during trial.

Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that it is a case of false implication and though, in the first information report as well as in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., allegation of sexual assault has been levelled, but in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the allegation of only attempt to rape has been levelled and in the medical examination report of the prosecutrix, no abnormality or any injury has been found.
Thus, the allegations of the F.I.R. are not supported by any medical evidence.

It is further submitted that there is no evidence pertaining to the pregnancy of the prosecutrix and and it appears that as applicant was against the marriage of her younger brother, Shoaib, with the prosecutrix, she, in order to pressurize the applicant, had instituted a false case against the applicant.

Elaborating further and while drawing the attention of this Court towards the statement of the prosecutrix recorded before the trial court, wherein she, though, in her examination-in-chief had supported the allegations of the F.I.R., but in cross-examination has resiled from the case of the prosecution, it is vehemently submitted that the prosecutrix in the cross examination had not supported any allegation as narrated by her in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and had categorically stated that as the instant applicant was against her marriage with his younger brother, Shoaib, she had instituted this false case and now, her marriage has been solemnized with Shoaib.

It is vehemently submitted that having regard to the admission of the prosecutrix of lodging a false case against the applicant, there is no possibility of the conviction of the applicant before the trial court and the applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 03.06.2022 and he is not having any criminal history.

He undertakes that he would remain present before the trial court as and when his presence would be required and would not take adjournment especially on the occasions when prosecution witnesses would be in attendance and also there is no apprehension that after being released on bail, he may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and, therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that the age of the prosecutrix has not been determined through 'ossification' process.
There is nothing on record which may reflect that the prosecutrix was an educated person.
The only evidence pertaining to her age are her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., wherein she had stated her age to be of 18 years.
Thus, it prima facie, appears that the prosecutrix was major at the time of the alleged incident.

The prosecutrix has also been testified before the trial court as P.W.-1 and a copy of her statement has also been brought on record through supplementary affidavit of date 13.02.2023 (filed today) and in the cross-examinaion, the prosecutrix appears to have become hostile and had categorically stated that as the instant applicant was against her marriage with his younger brother, Shoaib, she had instituted this false case.

The appreciation of the evidence of the prosecutrix would be an area earmarked for the trial court, but having regard to the totality of facts especially the statement of the prosecutrix recorded before the trial court, in the considered opinion of this Court, the applicant may be granted facility of bail.
Applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 03.06.2022 without any criminal antecedents.
The presence of the applicant may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

2 Let the accused/applicant- Nadeem involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
